label: benign
text: OTP for your login is 449281. Never share it with anyone. -HDFC Bank
note: #18 documents this as an accepted false positive. It passes because _GAP cannot cross the sentence boundary between the OTP and 'share' - so the accepted cost is narrower than the PR claims. If this ever starts firing, that trade-off has changed and someone must decide deliberately.

label: benign
text: Your KYC update is complete. Thank you for banking with us.
note: FALSE POSITIVE. _KYC_ACTION includes 'complet\w*' and 'updat\w*', so a completion notice trips kyc_expiry. Consistent with the documented over-warning policy, recorded so the cost is known rather than discovered.

label: scam
text: Refund of Rs 4,999 is pending. Tap the link to claim
note: Fires nothing: _GAP is [^.!?\n]{0,40}? and cannot cross the full stop. That boundary is load-bearing - it is what keeps en-benign-otp-warning-001 clean - so closing this needs a per-rule decision, not a blanket relaxation.

note: Fires nothing. The hi rules are Devanagari-only and the en share-verbs do not cover bataiye/batao/bhejo. Romanised Hindi is extremely common in real SMS and in STT transcripts, where output may not be Devanagari at all.
